y-m-05-08.title: Ubani omude, u-98cm noma 1m 5cm?
y-m-05-08.goal: Qaphela ukuthi ukuqhathanisa ubude obuneyunithi ehlukile ngokubheka izinombolo kuphela kunikeza impendulo engalungile. Qhathanisa ngokuguqulela eyunithini efanayo, bese uchazela umnawe ngamagama alula.
y-m-05-08.material: 1m ngu-100cm. Uma ukuphakama kubhalwe ngo-1m 5cm, kungubude bika-1m no-5cm ndawonye. Ukuphakama kukaSua ngu-1m 5cm, futhi ukuphakama kukaJiho ngu-98cm. Ukuze athole ukuthi ubani omude, u-Ido ukuxazulule njengoba kungezansi.
y-m-05-08.thinking.1: Ukuguqula phakathi kwe-m ne-cm ukwenza ubude obuhambisana nesimo
y-m-05-08.prereq.1: Ukufunda nokubhala ubude usebenzisa i-cm ne-m ndawonye
y-m-05-08.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa esixazululweni sika-Ido lapho ukuphakama kuqhathaniswa kabi okokuqala. (Imigqa ibalwa kusukela ku-1.)
y-m-05-08.s.s1.hint.0: Emigqeni lapho kuvela amagama aqhathanisa ukuphakama, hlola ukuthi amayunithi ahlanganiswe ngemva kwezinombolo eziqhathaniswayo ayafana yini.
y-m-05-08.s.s1.hint.1: Beka u-1m 5cm no-98cm eyunithini efanayo bese ubuqhathanisa nesiphetho sika-Ido.
y-m-05-08.s.s1.line.0: Ukuphakama kukaSua ngu-1m 5cm, futhi ukuphakama kukaJiho ngu-98cm.
y-m-05-08.s.s1.line.1: U-1m 5cm ungubude bika-1m no-5cm bengeziwe, futhi u-98cm kaJiho ungubude obungu-98cm.
y-m-05-08.s.s1.line.2: U-98 mkhulu kuno-1 noma 5, ngakho ukuphakama kukaJiho kukhulu.
y-m-05-08.s.s1.explain: Uqhathanisa kabi okokuqala emugqeni 3. U-1 ngu-m, u-5 ngu-cm, futhi u-98 ngu-cm, ngakho izinombolo ezineyunithi ehlukile aziqhathaniswa njengoba zinjalo. U-1m 5cm ungu-105cm, omude kuno-98cm. Isiphetho emugqeni 4 siqhamuka ekuqhathaniseni okungalungile emugqeni 3, ngakho liyiphutha elilandela kulo.
y-m-05-08.s.s2.prompt: Bhala ubude obu-3 obuhlukene, njengo-'m m cm', obude kuno-Sua (1m 5cm) futhi obufushane kuno-1m 20cm. (m iyinombolo yemvelo engu-0 noma ngaphezulu, futhi cm iyinombolo yemvelo kusukela ku-0 kuya ku-99.)
y-m-05-08.s.s2.hint.0: Beka u-1m 5cm no-1m 20cm eceleni komunye ngeyunithi efanayo, bese unquma kuqala ubude obuwela phakathi kwabo.
y-m-05-08.s.s2.hint.1: Hlukanisa kabusha ubude owabukhethile ube ngu-'m no-cm' bese uhlola ukuthi ingxenye ye-cm ayidluli ku-99.
y-m-05-08.s.s2.ok.c1: Ama-m nama-cm ayizinombolo zemvelo ezisemikhawulweni efanele.
y-m-05-08.s.s2.fail.c1: Ingxenye ye-cm kumele ibe kusukela ku-0 kuya ku-99. Uma ifinyelela ku-100cm, yibhale njengo-1m kunalokho.
y-m-05-08.s.s2.fail.c2: Akumude kunobude buka-Sua. Shintsha zombili izinsimbi zibe yeyunithi efanayo bese uziqhathanisa.
y-m-05-08.s.s2.fail.c3: Akumufushane kuno-1m 20cm. Shintsha zombili izinsimbi zibe yeyunithi efanayo bese uziqhathanisa.
y-m-05-08.s.s2.explain: U-1m 5cm ungu-105cm futhi u-1m 20cm ungu-120cm. Ubude obuphakathi bungu-106cm kuya ku-119cm, ngakho noma yini kusukela ku-1m 6cm kuya ku-1m 19cm iyasebenza. Uma ingxenye ye-cm ifinyelela ku-100 noma ngaphezulu, kumele uyiphakamisele ku-m lapho uyibhala.
y-m-05-08.s.s3.prompt: Umfowenu noma udadewenu osebangeni lokuqala uthe, "98 mkhulu kuno-1 noma 5, ngakho uJiho mude." Tshela umfowenu noma udadewenu ngamazwi alula ukuthi kungani kungafanele uqhathanise kanjalo, ukuze aqonde.
y-m-05-08.s.s3.hint.0: Cabanga ngento ongayisho eqala ngokubuza ukuthi izinombolo umfowenu noma udadewenu azaqhathanisa zibhalwe yini ngeyunithi efanayo.
y-m-05-08.s.s3.hint.1: Chaza ngamazwi umfowenu noma udadewenu angawaqonda ukuthi u-1m 5cm mude ngama-cm amangaki.
y-m-05-08.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe usho ngamazwi alula ukuthi ama-m nama-cm ayiziyunithi ezihlukene?
y-m-05-08.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe uqhathanise inani lika-1m 5cm eliguqulelwe ku-cm no-98cm?
y-m-05-08.s.s3.model.0: 1m ungu-100cm. Ngakho u-1m 5cm ungu-105cm. Uma uwubeka ngeyunithi efanayo no-98cm, u-105 mkhulu. Ngakho uSua mude.
y-m-05-08.s.s3.model.1: Ama-m nama-cm ayiziyunithi ezihlukene, ngakho akumele uqhathanise izinombolo kuphela. 1m ungu-100cm, ngakho uSua ungu-105cm futhi uJiho ungu-98cm.

y-m-05-04.title: Iyini Igama Lesimo 가?
y-m-05-04.goal: Qaphela ukuthi noma isimo sibukeka njengesikwele, kufanele ubale izinhlangothi namakhona aso ukuze usibize ngegama. Thola isixazululo esingalungile bese usibhala kabusha njengenothi.
y-m-05-04.material: Isimo 가 simise okwelẹta elithi 'ㄴ'. Siyisikwele esikhulu esikhishwe isikwele esincane kukhoneni elilodwa. U-Hangyeol uxazulule njengoba kukhonjisiwe ngezansi ukunquma igama lesimo 가.
y-m-05-04.thinking.1: Ukubiza isimo ngegama ngokwenani lezinhlangothi zaso, hhayi ukubukeka kwaso
y-m-05-04.prereq.0: Ukuzwa amagama okuthi unxantathu, i-quadrilateral, i-pentagon, ne-hexagon (izinga lebanga 2)
y-m-05-04.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa wokuqala esixazululweni sika-Hangyeol lapho ukucabanga kuphutha khona. (Bala imigqa kusukela enombolweni 1.)
y-m-05-04.s.s1.hint.0: Hlukanisa ukuthi umugqa ngamunye uyiqiniso elivela ekubaleni i-Figure 가 noma umbono ovela ekubukekeni kwayo.
y-m-05-04.s.s1.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi inombolo ebaliwe emugqeni wangaphambilini ihambisana nalokho okushiwo ngumugqa olandelayo.
y-m-05-04.s.s1.line.0: Ngibale izinhlangothi ze-Figure 가 futhi zingu-6, futhi kunama-vertex angu-6 nawo.
y-m-05-04.s.s1.line.1: I-Figure 가 imise okwesikwele esikhulu esikhishwe ikhoneni.
y-m-05-04.s.s1.line.2: Ivela esimweni sesikwele, ngakho i-Figure 가 i-quadrilateral.
y-m-05-04.s.s1.line.3: Ngakho i-Figure 가 isimo esinezinhlangothi ezi-4.
y-m-05-04.s.s1.explain: Iqala ukuphutha emugqeni 3. Emugqeni 1 izinhlangothi zabalwa zingu-6, ngakho ayikwazi ukuba yi-quadrilateral, enezinhlangothi ezi-4. Okunquma igama akulona lapho isuka khona kodwa ukuthi inezinhlangothi nama-vertex amangaki manje. Umugqa 4 uyisiphetho esiphikisana nenombolo ebaliwe emugqeni 1, ngakho uyiphutha elilandela ngemva komugqa 3.
y-m-05-04.s.s2.prompt: Khetha igama elilungile le-Figure 가 nesizathu esilungile sokuyibiza ngalelo gama.
y-m-05-04.s.s2.hint.0: Hlola futhi emugqeni 1 ukuthi i-Figure 가 inezinhlangothi ezingaki sekuyonke.
y-m-05-04.s.s2.hint.1: Qhathanisa inani lezinhlangothi ukukhetha ngakunye okukushoyo ne-Figure 가.
y-m-05-04.s.s2.r.a: Lokhu kucabanga ukuthi uma indlela eyenziwe ngayo ifana, igama liyafana. Bala ukuthi zingaki izinhlangothi manje.
y-m-05-04.s.s2.r.b: Lokhu kucabanga kunqume igama ngokubala inani lezinhlangothi nama-vertex.
y-m-05-04.s.s2.o.c: I-Pentagon: Uma ushiya ikhoneni elikhishiwe, kunezi-5.
y-m-05-04.s.s2.r.c: Lokhu kucabanga kulinganisele inani lezinhlangothi ngokukhipha noma ukwengeza indawo ekhishiwe. Bala imigqa yangempela ngayinye.
y-m-05-04.s.s2.explain: I-Figure 가 inezinhlangothi ezi-6 nama-vertex angu-6, ngakho i-hexagon.
y-m-05-04.s.s3.prompt: Bhala inothi ku-Hangyeol. Mtshele ukuthi ahlole ini ukwazi ukuthi isimo siyi-quadrilateral yini.
y-m-05-04.s.s3.hint.0: Qhathanisa, usebenzisa i-Figure 가, ukuthi ukubukeka njengesikwele kufana nokuba i-quadrilateral yini.
y-m-05-04.s.s3.hint.1: Enothini, bhala kokubili okufanele kuhlolwe nokuthi kufanele kube kangaki.
y-m-05-04.s.s3.placeholder: Isibonelo: Hangyeol, ukwazi ukuthi iyi-quadrilateral yini, ...
y-m-05-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe uvele inothi lakho ezinombolweni ezibaliwe, hhayi ekubukekeni?
y-m-05-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe usebenzise izinombolo ze-Figure 가 ukusho ukuthi kungani i-Figure 가 ingeyona i-quadrilateral?
y-m-05-04.s.s3.model.0: Hangyeol, noma ibukeka njengesikwele, awukwazi ukusho ukuthi iyi-quadrilateral. Kufanele ubale ukuthi inezinhlangothi ezi-4 nama-vertex angu-4 yini. I-Figure 가 inezingu-6, ngakho ayiyona i-quadrilateral.
y-m-05-04.s.s3.model.1: Ukwazi ukuthi iyi-quadrilateral yini, bala ukuthi kunemigqa eqondile emi-4 (izinhlangothi) yini. I-Figure 가 inezingu-6, ngakho ayiyona i-quadrilateral kodwa i-hexagon.

y-m-05-02.title: Zikhona izindlela ezingaki zokusebenzisa zonke izinduku?
y-m-05-02.goal: Usebenzisa inani lezinduku ezidingekayo unxantathu kanye ne-quadrilateral, thola izindlela ezihlukile zokusebenzisa zonke izinduku ezingu-31, futhi uchaze umthetho wokushintsha kusuka endleleni eyodwa kuya kwenye.
y-m-05-02.material: Kukhona izinduku ezingu-31 ezinobude obufanayo. Ungakha unxantathu oyedwa ngezinduku ezingu-3 kanye ne-quadrilateral eyodwa ngezinduku ezingu-4. Izinduku ezisetshenziswa emumweni owodwa zisetshenziselwa lowo mumo kuphela (azikho izinduku ezabelwana nezinye izimo). Ufuna ukusebenzisa zonke izinduku ezingu-31 ngaphandle kokushiya, futhi wenze unxantathu o-1 okungenani kanye ne-quadrilateral e-1 okungenani.
y-m-05-02.thinking.0: Ukuthola ukuthi isimo ngasinye sidinga izinduku ezingaki
y-m-05-02.thinking.2: Ukuthola umthetho wokuguqula indlela eyodwa ibe enye
y-m-05-02.prereq.0: Ukwazi ukuthi unxantathu unezinhlangothi ezi-3 futhi i-quadrilateral inezinhlangothi ezi-4 (izinga lebanga 2)
y-m-05-02.prereq.1: Ukwengeza izinombolo ezinezinombolo ezimbili, nokwengeza inombolo efanayo izikhathi eziningi
y-m-05-02.s.s1.prompt: U-Gaon wenze onxantathu abangu-6 nama-quadrilateral angu-3. Ingabe u-Gaon usebenzise zonke izinduku ezingu-31?
y-m-05-02.s.s1.hint.0: Qala ubale ukuthi zingaki izinduku sekuyonke ezidingekayo kwonxantathu abangu-6.
y-m-05-02.s.s1.hint.1: Bala nezinduku ezidingekayo kuma-quadrilateral angu-3, bese wengeza izinombolo ezimbili futhi uziqhathanise no-31.
y-m-05-02.s.s1.r.a: Lokhu kucabanga okuthole inani lezinduku zesimo ngasinye, kwazengeza, futhi kwaziqhathanisa no-31.
y-m-05-02.s.s1.r.b: Lokhu kucabanga okubheke kuphela inani lezimo, njengokuthi kwenziwa izimo ezingu-9 sekuyonke, noma kwahlulela ngaphandle kokuhlola inani lezinduku.
y-m-05-02.s.s1.r.c: Lokhu kucabanga okubale ngephutha inani lezinduku ezidingekayo konxantathu noma kwi-quadrilateral kanye. Bala futhi kusimo ngasinye.
y-m-05-02.s.s1.explain: Onxantathu abangu-6 badinga izinduku ezingu-18 nama-quadrilateral angu-3 adinga izinduku ezingu-12, ngakho izinduku ezingu-30 zisetshenzisiwe sekuyonke. Uma izinduku ezingu-30 kwezingu-31 zisetshenzisiwe, induku engu-1 iyasala.
y-m-05-02.s.s2.prompt: Yenza onxantathu abangu-t nama-quadrilateral angu-s, bese uthola izindlela ezintathu ezihlukile zokusebenzisa zonke izinduku ezingu-31. (t no-s ngamunye bayizinombolo zemvelo ezingu-1 noma ngaphezulu.)
y-m-05-02.s.s2.hint.0: Qala unqume inani lonxantathu, bese uthola ukuthi zisala zingaki izinduku zama-quadrilateral.
y-m-05-02.s.s2.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi ungenza ama-quadrilateral amangaki ngezinduku ezisele, nokuthi akusali zinduku yini.
y-m-05-02.s.s2.ok.c1: Kunonxantathu okungenani o-1 kanye ne-quadrilateral okungenani e-1.
y-m-05-02.s.s2.fail.c1: Amanani onxantathu nama-quadrilateral kufanele ngamunye abe yinombolo yemvelo engu-1 noma ngaphezulu.
y-m-05-02.s.s2.ok.c2: Sebenzisa zonke izinduku ezingu-31 ngaphandle kokusala.
y-m-05-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Izinduku ziyasala noma azanele. Engeza izinduku ezidingekayo konxantathu nezinduku ezidingekayo kuma-quadrilateral, bese uhlola ukuthi isamba singu-31 yini.
y-m-05-02.s.s2.explain: Lezi ziyenzeka: onxantathu abangu-9 ne-quadrilateral e-1 (27+4), onxantathu abangu-5 nama-quadrilateral angu-4 (15+16), unxantathu o-1 nama-quadrilateral angu-7 (3+28). Uma kunokungenani o-1 ngalunye, lezi zintathu zodwa ziyizindlela.
y-m-05-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Ngemva kokuthola indlela eyodwa, chaza ukuthi ungayithola kanjani ngokushesha enye indlela ngenkathi usasebenzisa ngqo izinduku ezingu-31.
y-m-05-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Bala ukuthi zisala zingaki izinduku uma uthatha abanye onxantathu endleleni oyitholile.
y-m-05-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi ungenza ama-quadrilateral amangaki angeziwe ngalezo zinduku.
y-m-05-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ingabe uhlolile futhi ukuthi indlela entsha nayo isebenzisa izinduku ezingu-31?
y-m-05-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ingabe usho ukuthi amanani onxantathu nama-quadrilateral ashintshana kanjani?
y-m-05-02.s.s2.because.model.0: Uma uthatha onxantathu abangu-4, kusala izinduku ezingu-12. Ungenza ama-quadrilateral angu-3 ngalezo zinduku, ngakho ungashintsha onxantathu abangu-4 babe ama-quadrilateral angu-3.
y-m-05-02.s.s2.because.model.1: Thatha onxantathu ngamunye bese ubala ukuthi uzuza ama-quadrilateral amangaki ezindukwini. Onxantathu abangu-4 nama-quadrilateral angu-3 bobabili basebenzisa izinduku ezingu-12, ngakho ukubashintshanisa kugcina isamba sikungu-31.
y-m-05-02.s.s2.because.model.2: Uma ususa onxantathu abangu-4 (izinduku ezingu-12) bese usebenzisa lezo zinduku ukwenza ama-quadrilateral angu-3, usebenzisa zonke ezingu-31 njengoba zinjalo.

y-m-05-01.title: Ukuba nama-vertex angu-3 kwenza umumo ube unxantathu?
y-m-05-01.goal: Cabanga ukuthi izimo ziyini umumo odinga ukuba unxantathu. Isikhathi ngasinye lapho ihlangana nomumo omusha, hlola ukuthi kukhona yini okuswele esitatimendeni sika-Arin, futhi ulungise isahlulelo sakho.
y-m-05-01.material: U-Arin wathi, "Umumo onama-vertex angu-3 unxantathu." Azikho izithombe, ngakho imimumo ichazwa ngamazwi. Uhlangothi ulayini ozungeza umumo, futhi i-vertex indawo ebukhali lapho izinhlangothi ezimbili zihlangana khona.
y-m-05-01.thinking.1: Ukubheka umumo omusha nokulungisa isahlulelo sakho
y-m-05-01.thinking.2: Ukuhlunga ukuthi yiziphi izimo ezidingekayo nokuthi yiziphi ezingadingeki
y-m-05-01.prereq.0: Ukwazi ukuthi izinhlangothi (imigqa ezungeza umumo) nama-vertex (amaphoyinti lapho izinhlangothi ezimbili zihlangana khona) ayini (izinga lebanga 2)
y-m-05-01.s.s1.prompt: Isikhathi ngasinye lapho kwengezwa enye incazelo yomumo, hlela umcabango wakho ngesitatimende sika-Arin.
y-m-05-01.s.s1.hint.0: Hlola, linye nelinye, ukuthi imimumo oyibonile kuze kube manje iphikisana yini nesitatimende sika-Arin.
y-m-05-01.s.s1.hint.1: Encazelweni entsha, bheka ukuthi izinhlangothi zinjani nokuthi imikhawulo yezinhlangothi yonke ixhumene yini.
y-m-05-01.s.s1.st.0.info: Umumo 가 wenziwe imigqa eqondile engu-3 exhumene ngaphandle kwezikhala, ezungeza yonke indawo. Unama-vertex angu-3 nawo.
y-m-05-01.s.s1.st.0.after: Isitatimende sika-Arin silungile kumumo 가. Kodwa ukulunga kumumo owodwa akusho ukuthi kulungile kuyo yonke imimumo.
y-m-05-01.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Singathenjwa. Umumo 가 unxantathu onama-vertex angu-3.
y-m-05-01.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Lo mcabango ubona ukuthi isitatimende silungile esibonelweni esisodwa. Ukuhlola eminye imimumo kungasenza siqiniseke kakhulu.
y-m-05-01.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Asikazi okwamanje. Sidinga ukubheka eminye imimumo eminingi.
y-m-05-01.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Lo mcabango ubona ukuthi isibonelo esisodwa sinzima ukusisebenzisa ukusho okuthile mayelana no-"yonke imimumo."
y-m-05-01.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Siphosile. Awukwazi ukubona unxantathu ngama-vertex awo.
y-m-05-01.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Lo mcabango unquma ukuthi isitatimende siphosile kuqala, ngaphandle kokubheka imimumo.
y-m-05-01.s.s1.st.1.info: Umumo 나 unama-vertex abukhali angu-3. Kodwa oyedwa wezinhlangothi zawo ezintathu ugobile ngaphandle ngomumo oyindilinga.
y-m-05-01.s.s1.st.1.after: Umumo 나 unama-vertex angu-3 kodwa akayona unxantathu. Isitatimende sika-Arin siswele isimo esithi "izinhlangothi ziyimigqa eqondile."
y-m-05-01.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Ama-vertex kufanele abalwe njengangu-4, hhayi angu-3.
y-m-05-01.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Lo mcabango ushintsha inombolo ukuze ihambisane nesitatimende, nakuba incazelo ithi kunama-vertex angu-3.
y-m-05-01.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Lo mcabango ubheka kuphela inani lama-vertex hhayi umumo wezinhlangothi.
y-m-05-01.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Umumo ungaba nama-vertex angu-3 futhi ungabi unxantathu.
y-m-05-01.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Lo mcabango ubona ukuthi kufanele ubheke umumo wezinhlangothi, hhayi inani lama-vertex kuphela.
y-m-05-01.s.s1.st.2.info: Umumo 다 wenziwe imigqa eqondile engu-3, kodwa uphukile endaweni eyodwa, ngakho awuzungezi yonke indawo.
y-m-05-01.s.s1.st.2.after: Uma uphukile ngisho endaweni eyodwa, akuwona umumo ozungeza yonke indawo. Noma ngemigqa eqondile engu-3, akuwona unxantathu.
y-m-05-01.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Lo mcabango ubheka nesimo sokuthi noma ngemigqa eqondile engu-3, kumele ivale umumo.
y-m-05-01.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Unxantathu. Umumo owenziwe ngemigqa eqondile engu-3.
y-m-05-01.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Lo mcabango ubheka kuphela inani nomumo wemigqa, hhayi ukuthi ixhumene yini.
y-m-05-01.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Uma isikhala esiphukile sincane kakhulu, unxantathu.
y-m-05-01.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Lo mcabango uthatha isikhala esincane njengokuvala. Cabanga ukuthi umumo ophukile ungabizwa ngokuthi uvaliwe yini.
y-m-05-01.s.s1.reflect: Ekuqaleni, ukuba nama-vertex angu-3 kwabonakala kwanele. Kodwa lapho sihlangana nomumo onohlangothi oluyindilinga nomumo ophukile, safunda ukuthi kunesimo esiswelekayo. Ukuthola ukuthi isitatimende silungile yini, kufanele sifune hhayi izibonelo ezifanelayo kuphela kodwa nezibonelo ezingafaneli.
y-m-05-01.s.s2.prompt: Khetha konke umumo okumele ube nakho ukuze ube unxantathu.
y-m-05-01.s.s2.hint.0: Cabanga futhi ngemiumbo 가, 나, no-다, futhi uqhathanise nokuthi umumo wawuyunxantathu nini nokuthi wawungeyona nini.
y-m-05-01.s.s2.hint.1: Ezimbonweni ezingesibo onxantathu, khetha linye nelinye ukuthi yini eyayiswele.
y-m-05-01.s.s2.r.a: Lo mcabango ubone kuphela onxantathu abanezinhlangothi ezilinganayo. Cabanga ukuthi bakhona yini onxantathu abanezinhlangothi ezinobude obuhlukile.
y-m-05-01.s.s2.r.b: Lo mcabango ubheke umumo wezinhlangothi njengesimo.
y-m-05-01.s.s2.o.c: Uvaliwe ngokuzungeza yonke indawo ngaphandle kwezikhala.
y-m-05-01.s.s2.r.d: Lo mcabango ubone kuphela onxantathu abanekhona elilungile. Bona futhi unxantathu onamakhona abukhali kuphela.
y-m-05-01.s.s2.r.e: Lo mcabango ubheke inani lezinhlangothi njengesimo.
y-m-05-01.s.s2.explain: Unxantathu ngumumo ovalwe ngokuzungeza yonke indawo, ngaphandle kwezikhala, yimigqa eqondile engu-3. Zonke izinhlangothi ukuba nobude obufanayo noma ukuba nekhona elilungile akusona isimo esidingekayo sikanxantathu.
y-m-05-01.s.s2.acc.0: Izimo ezimbili mayelana nokuvalwa yimigqa eqondile zilungile. Isimo sokuthi kunezinhlangothi ezingu-3 nasco kumele sibe khona ukuze ube unxantathu.

y-m-05-03.title: Zingaki izibhloko zokwakha uma sibona ingxenye engaphambili kuphela?
y-m-05-03.goal: Qaphela ukuthi inani eliphelele lezibhloko zokwakha alinakunqunywa ngokubukwa kwangaphambili kuphela, bese uthola wena ulwazi olukuvumela ukuthi ulinqume nezinombolo ezingenzeka.
y-m-05-03.material: Izibhloko zokwakha ziyizikwele zamapulangwe zosayizi ofanayo. Kunezindawo ezi-3 eceleni komunye nomunye kusuka ngakwesobunxele kuya ngakwesokudla. Emgqeni wangaphambili, indawo yesobunxele inezibhloko ezi-2 (amazinga ama-2), indawo ephakathi ino-1, nendawo yesokudla ino-1, ngakho umugqa wangaphambili unezibhloko ezi-4 sekuyonke. Kusuka phambili, kubukeka njengezitebhisi, ohlangothini lwesobunxele luphezulu ngezinga elilodwa. Kungase kube nomugqa ongemuva ngemuva komugqa wangaphambili, kodwa ufihlwe ngumugqa wangaphambili futhi awubonakali. Uma kukhona umugqa ongemuva, indawo ngayinye ayiphakanyiswanga ngaphezu kwendawo efanayo emgqeni wangaphambili (uma ibiphakeme, ibingabonakala kusuka phambili). Izibhloko aziyi emoyeni, futhi kunemigqa emibili kuphela, umugqa wangaphambili nomugqa ongemuva.
y-m-05-03.s.s1.prompt: U-Jihu wathi, "Kunezibhloko zokwakha ezingu-4 sekuyonke." Ngalokho esikwaziyo manje kuphela, singasho lokhu ngokuqinisekile?

y-m-05-03.s.s1.hint.1: Cabanga ngecala lapho umugqa ongemuva ungenazibhloko nhlobo nelicala lapho unazo ezinye.

y-m-05-03.s.s1.o.b: Kunezingu-4 okungenani. Asazi ukuthi kukhona yini umugqa ongemuva.
y-m-05-03.s.s1.r.b: Lokhu kucabanga kwahlulela ngokuhlukanisa ingxenye ongayibona nengxenye efihliwe.
y-m-05-03.s.s1.o.c: Kufanele kube nezibhloko emgqeni ongemuva, ngakho kunezi-5 okungenani.
y-m-05-03.s.s1.r.c: Lokhu kucabanga kucabanga ukuthi kufanele kube nezibhloko endaweni efihliwe. Cabanga ukuthi umugqa ongemuva ungaba ngowenalutho yini.
y-m-05-03.s.s1.explain: Izibhloko ezingu-4 emgqeni wangaphambili ziqinisekile, kodwa asikwazi ukubona ukuthi kukhona umugqa ongemuva yini. Ngakho singasho kuphela ukuthi kunezingu-4 okungenani.
y-m-05-03.s.s2.prompt: Khetha zonke izingcezu zolwazi lapho ukutshelwa ucezu olulodwa nje kwazo kukuvumela ukuthi unqume inani eliphelele lezibhloko zokwakha.
y-m-05-03.s.s2.hint.0: Bheka ukuthi lolo lwazi lukuvumela ukuthi wazi inani lezibhloko emgqeni ongemuva yini.
y-m-05-03.s.s2.hint.1: Hlunga ukuthi likhombisa nje lokho osuvele ukwazi noma alinakho ukwenza nenani.
y-m-05-03.s.s2.r.a: Lokhu kucabanga kukhethe ulwazi olungenakho ukwenza nenani. Cabanga ukuthi umbala ukutshela yini inani elifihliwe.
y-m-05-03.s.s2.o.b: Zingaki izinga ezinendawo ngayinye emgqeni ongemuva
y-m-05-03.s.s2.r.b: Lokhu kucabanga kubone ukuthi ukuphakama kwendawo ngayinye emgqeni ongemuva kukuvumela ukuthi uthole inani emgqeni ongemuva.
y-m-05-03.s.s2.r.c: Lokhu kucabanga kushiye ukuthi ukubuka kusuka eceleni kukhombisa kuphela izinga eliphakeme kakhulu lomugqa ngamunye. Cabanga ukuthi kunquma inani emgqeni ongemuva yini.

y-m-05-03.s.s2.explain: Umugqa wangaphambili usuvele waziwa ukuthi unezingu-4. Uma wazi inani emgqeni ongemuva noma inani lamazinga endaweni ngayinye, isamba sinqunyiwe. Umbala, ukubuka kusuka eceleni, noma ukubheka ukubuka kwangaphambili futhi akukwazi ngokwako ukunquma inani emgqeni ongemuva.
y-m-05-03.s.s2.acc.0: Uma wazi inani lamazinga endaweni ngayinye emgqeni ongemuva, ungalinquma inani. Ukutshelwa inani emgqeni ongemuva ngqo kwenza umsebenzi ofanayo.
y-m-05-03.s.s2.acc.1: Uma wazi inani emgqeni ongemuva, ungalinquma. Ukutshelwa inani lamazinga endaweni ngayinye kwenza umsebenzi ofanayo.

y-m-05-05.title: Ingabe ukusika kanye kuhlala kwenza unxantathu?
y-m-05-05.goal: Khombisa ngesibonelo esisodwa esiphikisayo ukuthi isitatimende esithi "Uma usika isikwele kanye ngomugqa oqondile, unxantathu uyavela" siphutha, bese ulungisa isitatimende ukuze sibe sihle.
y-m-05-05.material: Kukhona ucezu lwephepha elinemibala eliyisikwele elinezinhlangothi ezingu-6cm. Uxhumanisa iphoyinti P ohlangothini olungaphezulu nephoyinti Q ohlangothini olungaphansi ngomugqa oqondile bese usika. Iphoyinti P lingu-x cm ngakwesokudla kwesiphetho sesobunxele sohlangothi olungaphezulu, futhi iphoyinti Q lingu-y cm ngakwesokudla kwesiphetho sesobunxele sohlangothi olungaphansi. x no-y bayizinombolo zemvelo kusukela ku-0cm kuya ku-6cm, futhi uma ingu-0cm noma 6cm, iphoyinti liseziphethweni zomphetho (i-vertex). U-Seoyun wathi, "Uma usika isikwele kanye ngomugqa oqondile, esinye sezingcezu siyunxantathu."

y-m-05-06.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Ideski 가 libonakala lide, kodwa asiqinisekile.
y-m-05-06.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Lokhu ukucabanga kugcina isinqumo sokuqala kodwa kwehlisa ukuqiniseka.
y-m-05-06.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Asikwazi ukusho. Asazi ubude bezandla zabantu ababili.
y-m-05-06.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Lokhu ukucabanga kubona ukuthi amanani akalwe ngezindinganiso ezihlukile awakwazi ukuqhathaniswa.
y-m-05-06.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Lokhu ukucabanga kuphendule isinqumo sokuqala ngemva kokubona ulwazi olusha, kodwa kunzima ukunikeza isizathu.
y-m-05-06.s.s1.st.2.info: Isandla sikaGaeun singu-9cm, futhi isandla sikaNarae singu-13cm.
y-m-05-06.s.s1.st.2.ask: Kwenzekani uma ubonisa ubude bamadeski amabili nge-cm bese ubuqhathanisa?
y-m-05-06.s.s1.st.2.after: Ideski 가 lingu-9+9+9+9=36cm futhi Ideski 나 lingu-13+13+13=39cm. Ngisho nangezandla ezimbalwa, uma isandla ngasinye side, leli deski lingaba elide.
y-m-05-06.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Lokhu ukucabanga kulinganisele ukuthi umehluko ebudeni besandla uvumelana nomehluko enanini lezandla.
y-m-05-06.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Lokhu ukucabanga kucabanga ukuthi elinezandla eziningi lisalide.
y-m-05-06.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Lokhu ukucabanga kuthole ubude bedeski ngalinye nge-cm kwaliqhathanisa.
y-m-05-06.s.s1.reflect: Lapho umuntu ofanayo ekale, sikwazile ukuqhathanisa ngenani lezandla. Kodwa lapho abantu abahlukile bekale ngezandla zabo, kwakunzima ukusho ngokuqinisekile. Sikwazile ukuqhathanisa kuphela ngemva kokwazi ubude besandla esisodwa eyunithini efanayo (cm).
y-m-05-06.s.s2.prompt: Uma Ideski 가 (4 zezandla) Ideski 나 (3 zezandla) linobude obufanayo, thola amabhanqa amathathu ahlukene amanani esandla sikaGaeun a cm nesandla sikaNarae b cm. (Izandla zabantu bobabili ziyizinombolo zemvelo kusuka ku-8cm kuya ku-20cm.)
y-m-05-06.s.s2.hint.0: Nquma a, thola ukuthi izandla ezi-4 zikaGaeun zingakanani nge-cm, bese uthola b eyenza izandla ezi-3 zikaNarae zibe nobude obufanayo.
y-m-05-06.s.s2.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi b iyinombolo yemvelo futhi ingu-20 ubuningi.
y-m-05-06.s.s2.ok.c1: Izandla zabantu bobabili ziyizinombolo zemvelo kusuka ku-8cm kuya ku-20cm.
y-m-05-06.s.s2.fail.c1: Isandla kumele sibe yinombolo yemvelo kusuka ku-8cm kuya ku-20cm.
y-m-05-06.s.s2.fail.c2: Ubude bamadeski amabili abufani. Thola ukuthi izandla ezi-4 zikaGaeun nezi-3 zikaNarae zingakanani nge-cm, bese uziqhathanisa.
y-m-05-06.s.s2.explain: Uma isandla sikaGaeun singu-9cm nesikaNarae singu-12cm, zombili zingu-36cm, ziyafana. 12cm no-16cm (48cm), no-15cm no-20cm (60cm) nazo ziyenzeka. Phakathi kuka-8cm no-20cm, lezi zintathu ziyilezo kuphela.
y-m-05-06.s.s2.because.prompt: Bhala ukuthi kungani amadeski amabili angaba nobude obufanayo noma amanani ezandla ehlukile, 4 no-3.
y-m-05-06.s.s2.because.hint.0: Khetha ibhanqa elilodwa owalithole ngenhla bese ubeka isandla sikaGaeun nesikaNarae eceleni komunye nomunye.
y-m-05-06.s.s2.because.hint.1: Qhathanisa ukuthi isandla sinjani kulowo okale izikhathi ezimbalwa.
y-m-05-06.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ingabe usho ukuthi isandla somuntu oyedwa side?
y-m-05-06.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ingabe usho ukuthi lowo okale izikhathi ezimbalwa kumele abe nesandla eside ukuze ubude bufane?
y-m-05-06.s.s2.because.model.0: Isandla sikaNarae side kunesikaGaeun, ngakho ngisho nokukala izikhathi ezingu-3 kuphela kungabunikeza ubude obufanayo nokukala kukaGaeun izikhathi ezingu-4.
y-m-05-06.s.s2.because.model.1: Uma isandla sikaGaeun singu-9cm nesandla sikaNarae singu-12cm, ukwengeza u-9 izikhathi ezine no-12 izikhathi ezintathu kokubili kunikeza u-36cm, ziyafana. Uma isandla sikhulu, ukukala okumbalwa kungabunikeza ubude obufanayo.
y-m-05-06.s.s2.because.model.2: Ubude bezandla buyahluka kumuntu nomuntu, ngakho uma isandla sikaNarae side, ubude obufanayo bubamba izandla ezimbalwa.

y-m-05-07.title: Singazibala kanjani onxantathu esikwele ngaphandle kokushiya lutho?
y-m-05-07.goal: Qhathanisa izindlela zokubala onxantathu abakhulu nabancane esithombeni ngaphandle kokushiya noma ukubala kabili, lungisa ukubala okungalungile, bese wenza indlela yakho yokubala esithombeni esihlukile.
y-m-05-07.material: Kusukela phezulu ngakwesobunxele kuhamba ngokwewashi, biza ama-vertex amane ephepha eliyisikwele ngokuthi ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄷ, no-ㄹ. Xhuma ㄱ ku-ㄷ no-ㄴ ku-ㄹ ngemigqa eqondile, futhi imigqa emibili ihlangana endaweni maphakathi ㅁ. Sifuna ukubala bonke onxantathu abakhulu nabancane abangatholakala kulesi sithombe. Izinhlangothi zonke ezintathu zikanxantathu kumele zilele emigqeni edwetshwe esithombeni. (ㄱ ifundwa giyeok, ㄴ ifundwa nieun, ㄷ ifundwa digeut, ㄹ ifundwa rieul, futhi ㅁ ifundwa mieum.)
y-m-05-07.prereq.0: Ukwazi ukuthi unxantathu ngumumo ohambelwe yimigqa eqondile emi-3 (ibanga leBanga 2)
y-m-05-07.s.s1.prompt: Abangani abane bachaze ukuthi babala kanjani onxantathu. Khetha zonke izindlela ezingabala bonke onxantathu ngaphandle kokushiya noma ukubala kabili.
y-m-05-07.s.s1.hint.0: Ngendlela ngayinye, cabanga ukuthi yiziphi onxantathu abangase beshiywe.
y-m-05-07.s.s1.hint.1: Bheka ukuthi onxantathu ababalwe ngendlela ngayinye bangahlukaniswa yini ngaphandle kokudlulana.
y-m-05-07.s.s1.o.a: USeojin: Bala kuphela onxantathu abancane kakhulu.
y-m-05-07.s.s1.r.a: Lokhu ukucabanga akubali onxantathu abakhulu abenziwa ngokuxhuma onxantathu ababili abancane.
y-m-05-07.s.s1.o.b: UDaon: Qala ubale abancane, bese ubala abenziwe ngababili abancane abaxhunyiwe.
y-m-05-07.s.s1.r.b: Lokhu ukucabanga kuhlele ngosayizi kwabala ngokulandelana.
y-m-05-07.s.s1.o.c: UHajun: Khetha amaphoyinti angu-3 kwangu-5 ngesikhathi, kodwa shiya amaphoyinti amathathu asemugqeni oqondile owodwa.
y-m-05-07.s.s1.r.c: Lokhu ukucabanga kubala ngaphandle kokushiya ngokukhetha amaphoyinti, futhi kuhlunga izimo ezingenzi unxantathu.
y-m-05-07.s.s1.o.d: UYuna: Bala noma yini ebamba amehlo.
y-m-05-07.s.s1.r.d: Lokhu ukucabanga akunalo ukulandelana noma umthetho, ngakho kungase kushiye abanye noma kubale abanye kabili.
y-m-05-07.s.s1.explain: Ukubala ngokulandelana ngosayizi, nokukhetha amaphoyinti angu-3 ngesikhathi ngenkathi kushiywa amaphoyinti amathathu asemugqeni oqondile owodwa, kokubili kungabala bonke onxantathu. Ukubala kuphela abancane kakhulu, noma ukubala noma yini ebamba amehlo, kungashiya abanye.
y-m-05-07.s.s1.acc.0: Indlela kaDaon ingabala bonke. Indlela kaHajun ingabala bonke nayo.
y-m-05-07.s.s1.acc.1: Indlela kaHajun ingabala bonke. Indlela kaDaon ingabala bonke nayo.
y-m-05-07.s.s2.prompt: UMinu ukhethe amaphoyinti angu-3 kwangu-5 ngesikhathi wabala onxantathu. Khetha umugqa wokuqala ongalungile. (Bala imigqa kusukela enombolweni 1.)
y-m-05-07.s.s2.hint.0: Hlola ngakunye ukuthi okubaliwe noma okukhethiwe emugqeni ngamunye kuba unxantathu ngempela esithombeni.
y-m-05-07.s.s2.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi izinombolo ekwengezeni emugqeni wokugcina ziyahambisana yini nemigqa yangaphambilini.
y-m-05-07.s.s2.line.0: Onxantathu abancane ngu-ㄱㄴㅁ, ㄴㄷㅁ, ㄷㄹㅁ, no-ㄹㄱㅁ, ngakho kunabangu-4.
y-m-05-07.s.s2.line.1: Onxantathu abakhulu abenziwe ngabancane ababili abaxhunyiwe ngu-ㄱㄴㄷ, ㄴㄷㄹ, ㄷㄹㄱ, no-ㄹㄱㄴ, ngakho kunabangu-4.
y-m-05-07.s.s2.line.2: U-ㄱㅁㄷ nawo angamaphoyinti angu-3 akhethiwe, ngakho unxantathu.
y-m-05-07.s.s2.explain: Kuphosa okokuqala emugqeni 3. U-ㄱ, ㅁ, no-ㄷ basemugqeni oqondile owodwa (i-diagonal), ngakho abenzi unxantathu. Ngesizathu esifanayo u-ㄴ, ㅁ, no-ㄹ kumele nabo bashiywe, ngakho kunonxantathu abangu-8 sekukonke. U-9 emugqeni 4 awulungile ngoba uyisiphetho esiqhubeka nephutha emugqeni 3.
y-m-05-07.s.s3.prompt: Kulokhu, esikweleni ㄱ no-ㄷ kuphela abaxhunywe ngomugqa oqondile, futhi ㄴ no-ㄹ abaxhunyiwe. Bhala ukuthi kunonxantathu abangakanani sekukonke, futhi ubhale indlela obale ngayo ngaphandle kokushiya lutho.
y-m-05-07.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala yonke indlela yokukhetha amaphoyinti angu-3 kwangu-4, futhi uhlole ngakunye ukuthi zonke izinhlangothi ezintathu zamaphoyinti amathathu akhethiwe ziyadwetshwa yini.
y-m-05-07.s.s3.hint.1: Isimo lapho uhlangothi lungaba ngumugqa ongadwetshiwe akumele kubalwe njengonxantathu.
y-m-05-07.s.s3.placeholder: Isibonelo: Kunonxantathu abangu-.... Indlela engibale ngayo ngu-...
y-m-05-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe uhlole ukuthi zonke izinhlangothi ezintathu ziyadwetshwa lapho ukhetha amaphoyinti amathathu?
y-m-05-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ukhulume ngezimo ezingeke zibe ngunxantathu ngoba ㄴ no-ㄹ abaxhunyiwe?
y-m-05-07.s.s3.model.0: Kunabangu-2. Yi-ㄱㄴㄷ ne-ㄱㄷㄹ. Izindawo lapho umugqa udwetshiwe kuphela zingasetshenziswa njengohlangothi, ngakho ngaphandle kwe-ㄴㄹ akukho unxantathu omunye ongenziwa.
y-m-05-07.s.s3.model.1: I-diagonal ㄱㄷ ihlukanisa isikwele sibe onxantathu ababili, ngakho kunabangu-2. Ngikhethe amaphoyinti angu-3 futhi ngahlola ukuthi zonke izinhlangothi ezintathu ziyadwetshwa.
